caption:
Tap water that tastes like the pipes it traveled through is one of those problems people just put up with.

Bottled water adds up fast, and a lot of pitcher filters need replacing every few weeks, which makes clean water feel like more upkeep than it should be.

The Brita Large Water Filter Pitcher is built around a 10-cup capacity and a standard filter rated to last two months, and it holds a 4.6-star rating across 59,611 reviews.

It's BPA-free and runs $28.49 with one filter included — a straightforward way to get better-tasting water without constant upkeep.
